subject: design/implement-now-authenticated-review-obligations
statement: Process exit never verifies review. After a clean, non-truncated reviewer exit and successful `ProcessCoordinator.Complete`, implement-now accepts only the typed impl-review persistence result for the bound obligation/process/proposal/revision. The adapter is the single owner of artifact rendering, CRLF normalization, schema/render/binding validation, and exact-read of the native object named by its returned receipt; implement-now performs no artifact parsing, proposal-wide pagination, body search, or author selection.
